20022.long_desc: Easily add the Arcooda Pinball Arcade pinball library to your virtual pinball machine. Setup is often less than 10 minutes using the self-installation software, and supports both traditional and vertical virtual generic pinball machines. Arcooda Pinball Arcade Generic Cabinet software is developed in partnership with FarSight Studios, the makers of the number one video pinball software, The Pinball Arcade. It allows you to play pinball games on a full sized video pinball machine with full backglass and DMD support. Features include; Cabinet Support Improved game play and graphics/shading and with monitor adjustments, Arcooda Pinball Arcade software will unlock the traditional way to enjoy Pinball Arcade. Plunger and tilt support is available if mapping through xbox controller settings. Backglass and DMD Support Make the games become alive….Your video pinball now looks and feels like a real pinball machine. 3D Kinect Support 3D game play without glasses? Yes, just plug in your XBOX One Kinect into your PC (Windows 10 needed) to enjoy even more game variety on all 76 game tables. New Camera Angles for Video Pinball 4 New camera angles have been added – totally designed for full sized pinball tables. 76 Pinball Arcade Pinball Tables Standalone (no steam or internet needed) Arcooda Pinball Arcade software will come with 76 licensed pinball tables (this is $6.57usd per licensed table including cabinet mode). The Generic Arcooda Version Cabinet Software offers you a standalone software package (76 games are included) and you do not need to keep your cabinet connected to the internet. Simply use the self installation software to install onto your virtual pinball cabinet. This is the standalone generic version pinball software suitable for virtual pinball machines. It is fully licensed and the product will be sent to you via Fedex. This is a fully licensed product.
20022.meta_description: Arcooda Pinball Arcade includes 76 licensed video pinball games, software, and cabinet model as a standalone product. In less than 10mins, you will be up and running with this standalone licensed software and playing virtual pinball on your pinball machine.

20022.product_details: Game Titles 76 Game Titles are included on the Arcooda Pinball Arcade (Generic Version) software package, the entire game table list is; - Addams Family, The (+ Gold*) - Al’s Garage Band Goes On a World Tour - Attack from Mars - Big Shot - Black Hole - Black Knight - Black Knight 2000 - Black Rose - Bone Busters Inc. - Bram Stoker’s Dracula - Bride of Pin•Bot (The Machine) - Cactus Canyon - Cactus Jack’s - Centaur - Centigrade 37 - Central Park - Champion Pub, The - Cirqus Voltaire - Class of 1812 - Creature from the Black Lagoon - Cue Ball Wizard - Cyclone - Diner - Doctor Who - Doctor Who: Master of Time - Dr. Dude and His Excellent Ray - Earthshaker! - Eight Ball Deluxe - El Dorado - El Dorado: City Of Gold - Elvira and the Party Monsters - F-14 Tomcat - Fireball - Firepower - Fish Tales - Frank Thomas’ Big Hurt - FunHouse - Genie - Getaway: High Speed II, The - Gladiators - Goin’ Nuts - Gorgar - Haunted House - High Speed - Hurricane - Indianapolis 500 - Jack•Bot - Jacks Open - Judge Dredd - Junk Yard - Lights…Camera…Action! - Medieval Madness - Monster Bash - No Fear: Dangerous Sports - No Good Gofers - Party Zone, The - PIN•BOT - Red & Ted’s Road Show - Rescue 911 - Safe Cracker - Scared Stiff - Space Shuttle - Star Trek: The Next Generation - Swords of Fury - Tales of the Arabian Nights - Taxi - Tee’d Off - Terminator 2: Judgment Day - Theatre of Magic - Twilight Zone - TX-Sector - Victory - Whirlwind - White Water - WHO Dunnit - Xenon Cabinet Mode: this software will open cabinet mode settings in the game software allowing you to setup either 2 or 3 monitor screen virtual pinball machines. Monitors: our main screen is designed to be played in vertical (landscape) mode at startup (some virtual pinballs have their software starting in horizontal/portrait mode). If you want to make this into portrait mode, you may consider (with thanks to sebinouse) try the below solution: https://github.com/mjrgh/PinballY/issues/7#issuecomment-422501425 Keymapping: our software is designed to work with XBOX controller where you can map a number of features that include variable plunger and tilt functions. However, if your virtual pinball machine is using a keyboard encoder, you will need to use a mapper program such as X360CE which will remap keyboard strokes into XBOX 360 controller mode (XInput protocol); https://www.x360ce.com/ - 3D Kinect Support 3D game play without glasses? Yes, just plug in your XBOX One Kinect into your PC (Windows 10/11 needed) to enjoy even more game variety on all 76 game tables. For other support help with regards to the Generic Arcooda Pinball Arcade sofware, please review the FAQ section. PLEASE NOTE: This product has been developed in partnership with Farsight Studios, the makers of Pinball Arcade. It is an original and licensed product, designed to be installed and played. It is a standalone product that needs no coding/computer skills and has been designed to work without upgrades/modifications. We are therefore unable to modify/add/change any of the games or to "hack" etc the software for other options.
